settings.heading: Are your products brand new?
settings.row_content:
No – all Unboxed products are pre-owned or refurbished. Every item is carefully inspected, professionally tested, and restored to meet our quality standards before being listed. Each product page clearly shows the condition so you know exactly what to expect.

Our goal is to give premium items a second life, without compromising on performance or appearance.

settings.heading: What does “refurbished” actually mean?
settings.row_content:
Refurbished means the product has been checked, cleaned, tested, and restored to full working order. This may include replacing worn parts, repairing faults, and ensuring the device functions exactly as it should. All refurbished tech sold by Unboxed is:

  • Fully tested
  • Professionally cleaned
  • Verified for performance
  • Ready to use out of the box

settings.heading: Do all products come with a warranty?
settings.row_content:
Yes. Every purchase includes a 6-month Unboxed Warranty for peace of mind.

If your item develops a fault within this period that isn’t caused by damage or misuse, we’ll repair, replace, or refund it in line with your rights under UK consumer law. Full details are available on our Warranty & Your Rights page.

settings.heading: Can I return an item if I change my mind?
settings.row_content:
Yes. Because all orders are placed online, you have 14 days from delivery to change your mind.

If you decide an item isn’t right for you, simply reach out to us at contact@unboxed.store within 14 days and return the item in the same condition. Once received, we’ll issue a refund in line with our Refunds & Returns policy.

settings.heading: Are your devices unlocked and ready to use?
settings.row_content:
All smartphones sold by Unboxed are unlocked unless clearly stated otherwise. This means you can use them with any UK network.

Devices are reset, free of previous accounts, and ready to set up as new when they arrive.

settings.heading: How quickly will my order be dispatched?
settings.row_content:
Orders are processed quickly and dispatched from the UK. You’ll receive tracking details as soon as your order ships.

We aim to deliver promptly and keep you informed every step of the way. If you ever have a question about your order, our UK-based support team is just an email away at contact@unboxed.store.
